_about: Place-name lookup for the copilot: turns a name like 'Delhi' into an outline (GeoJSON) that the fire data can be queried with. Use it for places that are not in the geoBoundaries files (data/boundaries).

response_fields_used.display_name: full place name, e.g. 'Delhi, Old Delhi, Delhi, India'
response_fields_used.geojson: the outline (Polygon or MultiPolygon), simplified by polygon_threshold (degrees)

rules: Send a User-Agent that identifies the app (set above).
Cache results; do not look up the same name twice.
No bulk or automated mass lookups.
